pages.title: Ergo Supplies: ergonomic office furniture
pages.text: Ergo Supplies makes ergonomic chairs and desks for offices, clinics and schools. Browse our catalog, check an order, or contact support.

pages.title: EC-200 task chair
pages.text: The EC-200 is our best-selling task chair. Price: $315 per unit for 30 or more units. Adjustable armrests, mesh back, 5-year warranty. Lead time: 7 business days.

pages.text: Unused items can be returned within 30 days. Damaged items are replaced at no cost. Contact support through your account manager.

pages.text: Northwind supplies office furniture to businesses, clinics and schools across the Bay Area from our San Jose warehouse and showroom.
